title: Supplemental principles of law and equity.
bodyText: Unless displaced by any provision of this chapter, the principles of law and equity shall supplement the provisions of this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§200A-4]  Supplemental principles of law and equity.  Unless displaced by any provision of this chapter, the principles of law and equity shall supplement the provisions of this chapter. [L 2018, c 46, pt of §1]
